paragraphs: The X1 M35i has been a mainstay of the X1 diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early U11 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the U11 and later the U11, the X1 M35i switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X1 M35i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
